name: CRE Agents (Vic)
description:
CRE Agents (Vic) connects Claude to institutional-quality commercial real estate expertise and live market data across acquisitions, development, asset management, investment sales, investor reporting, and more. It supports 12 major property types, with more added regularly.

Once connected, simply say "Use Vic to..." in any chat. Vic identifies the right expert task and equips Claude with the specialized process, methods and live market data needed to complete it. Claude then follows the instructions and delivers the finished result. That might be a stabilized pro forma, parsed rent roll, zoning feasibility report, in-depth market report, clean operating statement, offering memorandum, investment committee memo, reconciled estoppel, or hundreds of other commercial real estate tasks.

The expertise is organized into Specialized Task Catalogs built by seasoned CRE professionals for specific roles, such as Investment Sales, Acquisitions, Asset Management, Development, Investor Relations & Reporting, plus a General CRE catalog. Every subscription includes an always-on universal baseline along with the catalogs you add, so Claude discovers only the expertise that's relevant to your work.

Running expert tasks and using the institutional methods is unlimited. Monthly data credits apply only when a task requires live market data, and only when Vic retrieves that data for Claude.

Sign in with the email associated with your active CRE Agents subscription.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CRE Agents (Vic) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CRE Agents (Vic) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.creagents.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CRE Agents (Vic) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CRE Agents (Vic) provides these MCP tools: account_status, discover_tasks, fetch_task_data, get_skill, get_skill_asset, get_skill_resource, get_task, list_tasks, search_data, and search_skills.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CRE Agents (Vic)?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CRE Agents (Vic) in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does CRE Agents (Vic) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CRE Agents (Vic) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CRE Agents (Vic) is developed by CRE Agents Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
